findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Callers relying on it as an authorization boundary can therefore expose one tenant’s documents to another. Preserve the tenant equality check or enforce equivalent authorization.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access unconditionally. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a target document’s `documentTenant` can read that cross-tenant document, bypassing the function’s authorization boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
